item.title: AKC Humane Fund Expands Mission to Support Pet Owners with Critical Veterinary Care
item.description: The AKC Humane Fund, a not-for-profit organization dedicated to helping dogs and the people who love them, today announced an expansion of its mission to provide direct support for low-income pet owners struggling to afford the cost of critical veterinary care.
